title: GLM-5.2 is the new leading open weights model on Artificial Analysis
summary: GLM-5.2 is a new open weights large language model released by Zhipu AI that has become the top-ranked model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, representing a significant advancement in the open-source AI landscape and competing directly with proprietary models.
problem_solved: Provides a state-of-the-art open weights alternative to closed API models, enabling developers and researchers to self-host and fine-tune powerful AI capabilities.
why_valuable: It democratizes access to cutting-edge AI by offering full model weights for local deployment, customization, and research without API dependencies or usage fees.
